value: You are a helpful assistant that can interact with a computer to solve tasks

notes: 1.1.0 (commit 3ea751c, installed from git; the PyPI 'sweagent' is a stale placeholder) through litellm: the one product header is 'User-Agent: swe-agent/<version>' set via extra_headers, next to litellm's x-stainless-raw-response. The system prompt is a single sentence shared in its opening with mini-swe-agent ('You are a helpful assistant that can interact with a computer…'); SWE-agent's ends 'to solve tasks', mini's with a period, and mini denies on this user-agent and on str_replace_editor/submit. Function-calling mode sends bash, str_replace_editor and submit; the thought_action text mode sends no tools and the same prompt, carried by headers plus identity. Anthropic-style cache_control blocks on the last two messages inside a chat-completions body; temperature 0, top_p 1, non-streaming. A text answer triggers 'Your last output did not use any tool calls!' requery turns. Captured under a private /root (unshare -Urm) because the local deployment writes to fixed absolute paths.
